independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Catalogue entries were used only to select names, never as confirmation.
method_limits: Coordinates from Nominatim/OpenStreetMap are discovery points and are explicitly marked when they do not prove a launch.
Rules were treated as confirmed only where an authority, municipality, federation or current zone operator supported them.
Image search candidates are stored separately and none is approved by search relevance alone.
Pexels and Unsplash API credentials were unavailable.

spots.name: Podersdorf Nordstrand
spots.identity: North/North-North kite and windsurf zones at Podersdorf am See, not the whole Neusiedler See.
spots.conditions: Shallow steppe lake, predominantly NW and usable W/SW; flat to choppy. Foil depth varies with the unusually shallow lake.
spots.access_rules: Marked corridors and launch zones; visible zone lycra required. From 10 May to 20 September the 200 m shore restriction applies outside statutory exceptions/zones.
spots.trip_value: Austria's strongest multi-school lake destination with strong infrastructure and a distinct landscape; worth a dedicated trip but world_class boundary remains editorial.

spots.name: Lake Silvaplana
spots.identity: Official water-sports area and marked entries on Lake Silvaplana; adjacent Lej Suot and Lej da Champfèr are prohibited waters.
spots.conditions: High alpine lake with reliable SW Maloja thermal, typically 3–6 Bft from mid-May to mid-October. S/W can be gusty; WNW is gusty/offshore and N is unsafe for kite.
spots.access_rules: Official entries and zones only; kite membership/day fee, skill licence and insurance required; private kite instruction prohibited; rescue is seasonal.
spots.trip_value: One of Europe's most distinctive and established high-alpine wind-sports destinations; too internationally exceptional for worth_trip.

spots.name: Ahrenshoop
spots.identity: Baltic beach at Ahrenshoop/Hohes Ufer; must not be conflated with Saaler Bodden launches.
spots.conditions: Exposed Baltic wave venue described for advanced riders; exact wind window and launch remain insufficiently current.
spots.access_rules: Beach ordinance controls storage/camping; national-park zoning applies to nearby Bodden waters. Exact currently authorized launch needs confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Strong art-village and dune-cliff setting, but current sport and launch evidence is too thin for acceptance.

spots.name: Amrum Norddorf
spots.identity: Water-sports school and launch area at Norddorfer Strand; the protected Amrumer Odde farther north is excluded.
spots.conditions: Tidal North Sea venue with large standing area and flatter water around low tide; stronger wind brings waves. Tides and changing wind make independent riding demanding.
spots.access_rules: Use designated National Park areas; no landing or riding at Amrumer Odde. Local school briefing and current signage are material.
spots.trip_value: Island journey, exceptional Kniepsand landscape and both flat/wave potential support worth_trip once the exact zone geometry is attached.

spots.name: Bork Havn
spots.identity: Surf beach immediately beside WestWind at the southern end of Ringkøbing Fjord.
spots.conditions: Very shallow flat-water bay, best broadly SW through W to NE; good beginner and freestyle terrain. Shoals, rocks and sudden depth transitions can damage fins.
spots.access_rules: Large rigging areas, nearby parking, toilets, showers, shop, school and rental; navigation near harbour and shifting shoals needs local briefing.
spots.trip_value: High-quality family and learner destination within the Ringkøbing Fjord/North Sea system, strong enough for worth_trip.

spots.name: Agger
spots.identity: A multi-launch area: Agger Tange ocean jetties and Krik Vig flat-water bay must be stored as related but distinct subspots.
spots.conditions: Ocean launches are advanced/expert with strong current and shorebreak; Krik Vig is shallow flat water usable from beginner to expert.
spots.access_rules: Protected wetland access restrictions apply on the tange; Nature Agency states no surfing within 1.5 km of the tange in the described Krik context, so exact zone mapping is essential.
spots.trip_value: Southern gateway to Cold Hawaii with complementary ocean and fjord riding; clearly worth a trip when represented as a cluster, not one homogeneous point.

spots.name: Bredene – Twins Club
spots.identity: Marked surf zone at Strandpost 1/Twins Club, not the entire four-kilometre Bredene beach.
spots.conditions: Open Belgian North Sea beach; detailed wind, current and level evidence remains incomplete.
spots.access_rules: Kitesurfing only in designated zone; bathing zones take priority in season. Club, food and instruction present.
spots.trip_value: Useful urban-coast club spot, but evidence does not show a distinctive enough travel reason beyond the wider Belgian coast.

spots.name: Hindeloopen
spots.identity: Designated IJsselmeer kite location behind the dike at Hindeloopen; no sandy beach.
spots.conditions: Shallow water, safe directions S–SW–W–NW, grass launch with limited space; open year-round.
spots.access_rules: Kitesurfing is prohibited elsewhere in the municipality unless a location is designated. Waterfront parking and shop exist; no beach or refreshments at the launch.
spots.trip_value: A valuable fallback when Workum is crowded, but that framing and limited launch experience indicate worth_checking_out rather than worth_trip.

spots.name: Cadzand-Bad – kite zone
spots.identity: Current official kite area is described around Moio Beach and a separate 't Zwin area; the raw name 't Haventje is not independently confirmed as the correct current identity.
spots.conditions: Broad flat sandy North Sea beach; spot-specific wind and level claims remain open.
spots.access_rules: Only marked zones; availability can depend on crowding. Local dune-transition signs and yellow buoys govern use; camping is prohibited.
spots.trip_value: Potentially worth_trip as part of the Zeeland/Flanders coast, but identity and subspot geometry must be resolved first.

spots.name: Razo
spots.identity: Praia de Razo at Carballo, distinct from the connected Baldaio landscape and its separate access points.
spots.conditions: Exposed sandy beachbreak with high consistency, variable peaks, wind and strong-current potential; level depends heavily on swell.
spots.access_rules: Parking, toilets, lifeguards, accessibility and nearby restaurants are documented; protected natural setting requires marked access.
spots.trip_value: Costa da Morte scenery, consistent surf and WSL QS status make it worth_trip without clearly reaching world_class.

spots.name: Platja del Grau, Pals
spots.identity: Platja del Grau is the most sport-specific part of the wider 3.5 km Platja de Pals; Platja Gran should not be silently merged.
spots.conditions: Sandy open beach with N/NE Tramuntana/Gregal and SW/S/SE winds documented; conditions range from beginner instruction to exposed sea.
spots.access_rules: Kitesurf is restricted during peak beach use from 1 June to 30 September; marked access channels, two schools and a sailing club.
spots.trip_value: Long scenic Costa Brava beach with multiple wind systems and strong cultural/nature surroundings supports worth_trip.

spots.name: Baie de Pont-Mahé
spots.identity: Shallow bay at Assérac/Pénestin; launch and seasonal glide/swim separation must be assigned to the correct side of the inter-regional bay.
spots.conditions: Very shallow, highly tide-dependent Atlantic bay; broad standing area at suitable tide, with foil depth a material limitation.
spots.access_rules: Natura 2000 landscape; seasonal kite zoning and a buffer from bathing must be followed. Tide planning is essential.
spots.trip_value: Distinct shallow-water learning/freeride bay on an attractive coast; worth_trip after exact launch and current zoning are attached.

spots.name: Algajola / Aregno Plage
spots.identity: Aregno Plage is the long sandy beach serving Algajola; the nearby San Damiano cove is a separate calmer site.
spots.conditions: Libecciu/Maestral can create wind and waves; at other times the bay can be calm. Exposed days require condition-specific level guidance.
spots.access_rules: Local windsurf/kayak/paddle base operates seasonally; exact kite launch zoning and bathing-season rules remain open.
spots.trip_value: Corsican mountain-and-sea landscape, village access and wave/wind variety create a defensible worth_trip reason.

spots.name: Beauduc – Plage de la Comtesse
spots.identity: The authorized kite sector is Plage de la Comtesse at Beauduc; central beach and bird-protection point have different uses.
spots.conditions: Remote, spacious Camargue flat/chop kite environment with variable access-track condition and high wind exposure.
spots.access_rules: Kite only in Comtesse sector; vehicles park at natural lot and width restriction applies; camping/caravanning prohibited; bird enclosure restrictions 1 April–30 September.
spots.trip_value: An iconic European kite destination with exceptional landscape and established travel identity; classify world_class rather than worth_trip.

spots.name: Keros Beach, Lemnos
spots.identity: Keros Bay on eastern Lemnos, within a Natura 2000 ecosystem; school concessions and protected-beach policy require current confirmation.
spots.conditions: Long sandy bay, 50–100 m standing area, flat and wave sections, N/NE Meltemi roughly June–November; rocks mainly at bay ends.
spots.access_rules: Organized activity is politically and environmentally sensitive because of Natura 2000 and the 'untouched beaches' decision; current concession/zone status must be checked before publication.
spots.trip_value: Official municipality calls it globally known and a top European wind/kite destination; world_class rather than worth_trip.

spots.name: Sigri
spots.identity: Wind-sports centre at the northern end of the Gulf of Sigri; the village beach and Panagia Faneromeni are separate beaches.
spots.conditions: Wind-exposed western Lesvos with a protected island/harbour geography; detailed launch winds, depth and level remain insufficiently primary-sourced.
spots.access_rules: Organized centre and lessons documented; ferry access is seasonal and exact centre/launch coordinate must be confirmed.
spots.trip_value: Remote island setting plus Petrified Forest and multi-day wind destination support worth_trip after launch details are corrected.

spots.name: Neretva Estuary kite beach
spots.identity: Official kite area on the sandy Neretva river mouth near the coastal Komin/Ploče area; not inland Komin and not the whole wetland.
spots.conditions: Shallow flat estuary water and steady thermal wind, with open sections for advanced riders; river temperature/current and bird habitat are material.
spots.access_rules: Official kite area and camping exist next to sensitive waterbird habitat; exact authorized polygon, season and conservation conditions remain open.
spots.trip_value: Unusual river-sea landscape, flat water and Croatian travel context support worth_trip only with strict environmental and coordinate correction.

spots.name: Bol / Zlatni Rat
spots.identity: Wind-sports use around protected Zlatni Rat west of Bol; exact windsurf launch may be adjacent to, not on, the crowded tip.
spots.conditions: Thermal/Maestral wind and clear Adriatic water; pebble spit, currents, heavy bathing use and boat traffic require zone-specific guidance.
spots.access_rules: Protected natural area two kilometres from Bol with car, walking, tourist train and boat access; current sport corridors need primary confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Globally recognizable landscape and riders from around the world make this an internationally outstanding destination; world_class boundary is exceeded.

spots.name: Badesi – Li Junchi
spots.identity: Authorized kite area near the end of the Li Junchi seafront, distinct from Badesi's other long beaches.
spots.conditions: Long exposed sandy north Sardinian coast, Maestrale and waves; likely intermediate outside supervised instruction. Rocky ends and seasonal bathers are hazards.
spots.access_rules: Authorized kite area and recovery service reported by local association; paid parking, toilets, showers, changing and food documented. Current coastguard corridor rule still needed.
spots.trip_value: Long scenic Sardinian beach with multiple board sports and less fame than Porto Pollo supports worth_trip after legal-zone confirmation.

spots.name: Talamone – Fertilia Bay
spots.identity: Shallow wind-sports area at Fertilia beach/eastern Talamone bay, not the rocky village beaches Cannone or Bagno delle Donne.
spots.conditions: Shallow flat sandy bay; summer NW Maestrale thermal can be side-off/gusty, southern winds more onshore. Beginner suitability is conditional on school and direction.
spots.access_rules: Schools, rental, camping and accommodation present. Bathing-season corridor and coastguard rules must be linked to the exact launch.
spots.trip_value: Distinct Maremma landscape, thermal flat water and cultural/nature surroundings support worth_trip.

spots.name: Mellieħa Bay / Għadira Bay
spots.identity: Malta's large sandy Għadira/Mellieħa bathing bay; no exact dedicated windsurf launch was independently established.
spots.conditions: Shallow sheltered family bay; NE can create choppy exposure, but the source base does not establish reliable wind-sports travel conditions.
spots.access_rules: Public beach, showers/changing, buses and seasonal water-sports concessions; exact windsurf zone and rental availability remain open.
spots.trip_value: Strong general Malta beach value but insufficient evidence for a dedicated windsurf worth_trip listing.

spots.name: Rewa
spots.identity: Puck Bay water-sports area at Rewa and its sand spit; distinct from Puck town and Chałupy corridor.
spots.conditions: Shallow relatively warm bay water with favourable winds; conditions and level vary across the spit sides, and the exact beginner claim needs modern primary support.
spots.access_rules: Several schools documented, but current local zones, nature constraints and launch geometry remain open.
spots.trip_value: Distinct sand-spit landscape and alternative Puck Bay base plausibly support worth_trip after current rules and entry are verified.

spots.name: Esposende – Cávado estuary
spots.identity: Authorized kite area on Rio Cávado in front of the Esposende lifeboat station, south/southwest of two marked yellow buoys.
spots.conditions: Tidal estuary flat/chop with Atlantic wave beach across the spit; current and tide can materially reinforce or oppose wind.
spots.access_rules: Legal kite polygon is explicitly coordinate-defined; navigation channel and yellow buoys must remain clear. Nature and dune context need exact protected-area guidance.
spots.trip_value: Combination of authorized flat-water estuary, Atlantic surf and northern Portugal travel setting supports worth_trip.

spots.name: Praia do Cabedelo, Figueira da Foz
spots.identity: Cabedelo beach south of the Mondego mouth; Cabedelinho and Buarcos are separate spots.
spots.conditions: Long sandy beachbreak beside river mouth and breakwater; currents near the bar and winter swell can be strong. Summer learning conditions are more common.
spots.access_rules: Wooden dune walkways, parking, surveillance, accessibility and schools documented; bath zones take priority and sport must stay outside marked swimming areas.
spots.trip_value: Established surf history, varied peaks and strong city/region infrastructure support worth_trip without current proof of world_class status.

spots.name: Lagoa de Óbidos
spots.identity: Large tidal lagoon with multiple schools and launches; Foz do Arelho ocean beach and Bom Sucesso side require separate entry records.
spots.conditions: Flat/shallow lagoon sections, tidal current and variable depth/weed; open-ocean conditions outside the mouth are separate.
spots.access_rules: Spatial water-use plan has unrestricted and restricted areas. A 2026 seasonal navigation prohibition affected the downstream lagoon from 13 June to 13 September; future-year notices must be rechecked.
spots.trip_value: Distinct lagoon, multiple disciplines and nearby Peniche/Óbidos travel context support worth_trip after exact launch and current-year legal map are attached.
